What I am checking: Privileged accounts have an owner, approval, review history, and are changed or removed when no longer needed.

What I am checking: Admins only have the privileges needed for approved administrative work.

Control: IA-2(1) Multi-Factor Authentication to Privileged Accounts

What I am checking: Privileged activity is logged and reviewed for suspicious or unauthorized actions.

What I am checking: Network zones are separated and only approved traffic can cross boundaries.
Evidence I would review: Network diagram, firewall rules, ACL export, VLAN list

What I am checking: Traffic between network zones follows approved business flows.
Evidence I would review: Approved traffic matrix, firewall rule export, change approval records

What I am checking: Remote users can only reach internal systems approved for their work.

What I am checking: Network and firewall settings have an approved baseline.

What I am checking: Network and firewall changes are approved, documented, and reflected in the baseline.

What I am checking: The organization defines which security events must be logged.

Control: AU-6 Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
What I am checking: Collected logs are reviewed for suspicious activity.
Evidence I would review: SIEM alerts, review notes, escalation records

What I am checking: Monitoring detects suspicious authentication, network, endpoint, and administrative activity.
